citations.claim: E approach wait 201 with queue 91 at red while NS green held - max_wait violation
E wait 115 building during prolonged NS green under detector_fail
detector_fail active on N at step 562, EW wait already 77

counterfactual.change: Removed detector_fail event on N (events=[]); controller then sees all demand and cycles to EW before max_wait

explanation: Actuated controller with detector_fail on N hides N queue (0). NS green persists indefinitely; EW approaches E and W build queues (91 and 116) and wait exceeds 200s (201 at step 686). Removing detector_fail restores visible demand and proper cycling, eliminating violation.

violation.detail: approach 1 has waited 201 s at red with vehicles queued (limit 200)

vision_note: From steps 683 to 686 the east-west approaches stay blocked at red, with long blue-dotted queues stretching away from the intersection and red stopped vehicles never advancing through. The intersection state is frozen with no signal change to serve the waiting EW traffic, leaving them queued indefinitely while the crossing remains idle.
